title: KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation

paragraphs.en: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage: https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/ .

paragraphs.en: Humanoid robots can learn impressive whole-body skills by tracking a reference motion with reinforcement learning. Whereas a locomotion reference specifies only the body motion [ 21 , 18 ] , a loco-manipulation reference must specify synchronized whole-body, hand, and object trajectories. Such references must vary with the interaction behavior and the scene layout, and each must match the kinematics of the target robot and the geometry of its task. Many tasks further require the object to reach a prescribed pose. Obtaining such references remains a central bottleneck. Human demonstrations must be reconstructed and retargeted to the robot, which introduces embodiment errors, and teleoperation requires substantial human effort to cover the variation in behaviors, objects, scenes, and goals.

paragraphs.en: Video generators offer a scalable alternative: text and image conditioning can produce diverse, scene-conditioned interaction behaviors without manually collecting every demonstration [ 12 , 17 ] . For humanoids, recent methods either generate human–object interactions and retarget the recovered motion to the robot [ 22 , 31 ] or generate the target robot directly [ 1 , 32 ] . For the first family, since the behavior is generated and reconstructed through a human body proxy, the robot’s kinematics and the exact task instance constraints can only be satisfied after generation, which can cause penetration and drifting. The second family still relies on human-motion recovery and retargeting or a separately trained robot-specific pose detector, and recovers neither hands nor objects. Consequently, these pipelines do not directly recover complete whole-body, hand, and object references through the robot and object models that define the task instance. Moreover, text- or image-conditioned generation is open loop with respect to metric task requirements. The outcome may depict the intended behavior but cannot be revised to satisfy a prescribed configuration. We need references that are generated for the target robot in the exact task instance and can be customized to satisfy a prescribed configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成器提供了一种可扩展的替代方案：通过文本和图像条件约束，可以在无需手动收集所有演示的情况下，生成多样化且受场景条件制约的交互行为 [ 12 , 17 ] 。 对于类人机器人而言，近期的方法要么生成人与物体的交互动作，并将恢复的运动重新映射到机器人上 [ 22 , 31 ] ，要么直接生成目标机器人的动作 [ 1 , 32 ] 。 对于第一类方法，由于行为是通过人体代理生成和重建的，因此只有在生成之后才能满足机器人的运动学特性以及具体任务实例的约束条件，这可能导致穿模和漂移。 第二类方法仍然依赖人类动作的恢复与重新映射，或一个单独训练的机器人专用姿态检测器，且无法恢复手部或物体的动作。 因此，这些流程无法通过定义任务实例的机器人和物体模型，直接恢复完整的全身、手部和物体参考信息。 此外，基于文本或图像的条件生成过程与具体的任务指标要求之间是开环的。 生成的结果可能描绘了预期的行为，但无法根据预设的配置进行修改。 我们需要为特定任务实例中的目标机器人专门生成的参考信息，并且这些参考信息必须能够根据预设的配置进行定制调整。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight, as shown in Fig. 1 , is that a pretrained video generator and a physics simulator can be coupled through rendering and reconstruction using the same robot and object models. The generator supplies the interaction behavior, and the simulator supplies the exact embodiment and task geometry. Rendering the simulated task instance into the conditioning image places the generated behavior in the target embodiment and scene, and fitting the same models to the generated video returns the behavior to the simulator. We refer to this coupling as kinematic grounding. It has two consequences. The complete body, hand, and object reference is recovered directly in the robot configuration space and the object pose space by construction, without a human body proxy, retargeting, or a pose detector. In addition, a keyframe edited in simulation is simply another rendered state, so the same interface lets the generator regenerate the behavior around the edit while reconstruction enforces it exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解如图 1 所示：一个预训练的视频生成器和一个物理模拟器可以通过使用相同的机器人和物体模型进行渲染与重建而耦合在一起。 生成器提供交互行为，而模拟器提供精确的实体形态和任务几何结构。 将模拟的任务实例渲染为条件图像，可将生成的行为置于目标实体和场景中；而将相同模型拟合到生成的视频上，则能将行为重新返回模拟器。 我们将这种耦合称为“运动学接地”。它会产生两个后果。 通过构造过程，完整的身体、手和物体参考信息可以直接在机器人配置空间和物体姿态空间中恢复，无需使用人体代理、重定向或姿态检测器。 此外，在模拟中编辑的关键帧本质上只是另一个渲染状态，因此相同的接口能让生成器围绕该编辑重新生成行为，同时重建过程会确保其完全符合预期。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present KinoGen , a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen first grounds generation by conditioning the video generator on renders of the task instance from two calibrated views, so that the generated clip depicts the target robot with dexterous hands in the specified scene. It then reconciles the generated video with body, hand, and object priors to initialize reconstruction with plausible motion. Next, it fits the robot and object models to both views by direct optimization in the configuration space to recover the complete reference. Finally, a user may prescribe a goal object pose, and KinoGen edits the corresponding keyframe in simulation, renders it back into the generator, and enforces it in constrained reconstruction to obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 KinoGen——一个通过基于运动学的视频生成来合成可定制的人形机器人位姿与操作参考的框架。 KinoGen 首先通过用两个经过校准视角的任务实例渲染图像对视频生成器进行条件约束，从而确保生成的片段能够展示目标机器人在指定场景中使用灵巧双手的情景。 接着，它将生成的视频与身体、手和物体的先验知识进行协调，以合理的运动初始化重建过程。 随后，它通过直接在配置空间中进行优化，将机器人和物体模型适配到两个视角中，从而恢复完整的参考数据。 最后，用户可以指定目标物体的位姿，KinoGen 会在模拟中编辑对应的关键帧，将其重新渲染回生成器，并通过受约束的重建过程强制实现该位姿，以获得完全满足指定位姿的参考数据。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate KinoGen on eight loco-manipulation tasks for a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands, spanning sitting, kneeling, mopping, and the lifting of boxes, baskets, chairs, dumbbells, and basketballs. Against three video-based reference pipelines, KinoGen yields the lowest penetration and foot skating, preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and trains tracking policies with the highest success rate. Ablations show that the second view, point tracks, and motion priors each contribute to accurate and coherent reconstruction. In reference customization, KinoGen satisfies every prescribed target while incurring substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Finally, tracking policies trained on the synthesized references execute four of the tasks on the physical robot.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在八个局部操控任务上对 KinoGen 进行了评估，这些任务涉及一个配备灵巧手的 Unitree G1 人形机器人，包括坐姿、跪姿、拖地，以及抬升箱子、篮子、椅子、哑铃和篮球。 与三种基于视频的参考生成流程相比，KinoGen 的穿透和脚部滑移现象最低，保留了超过 90% 的标注接触点，并以最高的成功率训练出跟踪策略。 消融实验表明，第二视角、点轨迹和运动先验各自都对准确且连贯的重建起到了作用。 在参考定制过程中，KinoGen 能够满足所有预设目标，同时比直接插值产生的穿透现象显著更少。 最后，在合成参考数据上训练的跟踪策略能够在实体机器人上执行其中四个任务。

paragraphs.en: Humanoid loco-manipulation. Humanoid whole-body control has advanced rapidly through reinforcement learning and imitation from human motion [ 21 , 34 ] . Meanwhile, dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation couples high-dimensional whole-body motion with contact-rich object interaction, requiring coordinated robot–object references [ 36 , 33 , 30 ] . Previous methods use references commonly originated from teleoperation or human motion capture [ 6 , 10 , 35 ] which limits coverage to captured interactions and can introduce retargeting errors.

paragraphs.en: Video generators for robot data synthesis. Video generators have been used as world models and a scalable source of demonstrations from which motion references can be recovered [ 12 , 17 ] . For object-centric manipulation, RIGVid [ 23 ] extracts a 6D object trajectory from a generated demonstration. For humanoid data synthesis, recent approaches either generate human or proxy interactions and retarget the recovered motion [ 22 , 37 , 31 ] , or depict the target robot but recover its motion through human-motion retargeting, a robot-specific pose detector, or sparse point guidance [ 1 , 32 , 4 ] . GRAIL [ 31 ] grounds its proxy in the scene, but still requires retargeting to recover robot motion. Large-scale robot-video models such as Uni-Mo [ 19 ] and OmniHumanoid [ 28 ] further demonstrate that embodiment-conditioned generation can scale across robots, but do not recover complete robot–object reference trajectories. In contrast, KinoGen conditions generation on calibrated renders of the simulator state of the task instance, and fits those same models to multi-view evidence, following a render-and-compare formulation [ 16 ] . This directly recovers coordinated body, hand, and object trajectories, without a human body proxy or a separately trained robot-specific pose detector.
paragraphs.zh: 用于机器人数据合成的视频生成器。 视频生成器已被用作世界模型，并成为可扩展的演示数据来源，从中可以恢复运动参考 [ 12 , 17 ] 。 对于以物体为中心的操控任务，RIGVid [ 23 ] 会从生成的演示中提取 6D 物体轨迹。 在类人机器人数据合成方面，近期的方法要么生成人类或代理交互并重新映射恢复的运动 [ 22 , 37 , 31 ] ，要么描绘目标机器人，但通过人类运动重新映射、针对机器人的专用姿态检测器或稀疏点引导来恢复其运动 [ 1 , 32 , 4 ] 。 GRAIL [ 31 ] 将其代理锚定在场景中，但仍需通过重新映射来恢复机器人运动。 大型机器人视频模型（如 Uni-Mo [ 19 ] 和 OmniHumanoid [ 28 ] ）进一步表明，基于具身条件的生成可以在不同机器人之间扩展，但它们无法恢复完整的机器人–物体参考轨迹。 相比之下，KinoGen 以任务实例模拟器状态的校准渲染结果作为生成条件，并遵循“渲染-比较”框架，将这些模型与多视角证据进行拟合 [ 16 ] 。 这种方法可以直接恢复协调一致的身体、手和物体轨迹，而无需人类身体代理或单独训练的机器人专用姿态检测器。

paragraphs.en: Customizable video generation and editing. Generated videos may express the intended task without satisfying a prescribed metric configuration. Prior work controls generated motion using event keyframes, edge maps, rendered trajectories, or cross-embodiment editing [ 11 , 3 , 15 , 7 ] ; other methods treat the video as fixed and ground its output through downstream optimization or simulation [ 8 , 38 , 9 ] . GRAIL mentions terminal-frame conditioning but does not evaluate intermediate edits. None of these methods regenerates motion from an edited reconstructed robot–object state and then enforces that state exactly in the recovered reference. Through kinematic grounding, KinoGen closes this loop by rendering an edited reconstructed robot–object keyframe for keyframe-conditioned regeneration and enforcing the complete keyframe as a hard constraint during reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 可自定义的视频生成与编辑。 生成的视频可能表达了预期任务，但未必满足预设的指标配置要求。 先前的工作通过事件关键帧、边缘图、渲染轨迹或跨化身编辑来控制生成的运动 [ 11 , 3 , 15 , 7 ]；其他方法则将视频视为固定不变，并通过下游优化或模拟来对其输出进行约束 [ 8 , 38 , 9 ]。 GRAIL 提到了终端帧的条件约束，但未对中间编辑进行评估。 这些方法中没有任何一种能够根据编辑后的重建机器人–物体状态重新生成运动，并在此后严格确保该状态在恢复的参考视频中完全一致。 通过运动学约束，KinoGen 实现了这一闭环：它首先为关键帧条件再生渲染一个编辑后的重建机器人–物体关键帧，并在重建过程中将该完整关键帧作为硬性约束加以执行。

paragraphs.en: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation, as summarized in Fig. 2 . Central to our approach is the bidirectional interplay between a pretrained video generator and a physics simulator through rendering and reconstruction. The generator supplies the interaction behavior, and the simulator supplies the exact embodiment and task geometry. KinoGen thereby combines the generative prior of the video model with the kinematic constraints of the simulator to synthesize diverse and customizable references for learning loco-manipulation skills.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 KinoGen，这是一个通过基于运动学的视频生成来合成可定制的人形机器人移动与操作参考的框架，如图 2 所示。 我们方法的核心在于预训练视频生成器与物理模拟器之间通过渲染和重建实现的双向交互。 生成器提供交互行为，而模拟器则提供精确的实体形态和任务几何结构。 因此，KinoGen 将视频模型的生成先验知识与模拟器的运动学约束相结合，从而合成多样化且可定制的参考数据，用于学习移动与操作技能。

paragraphs.en: KinoGen proceeds in four stages. We first ground generation by conditioning the video generator on renders of the target robot itself (Sec. III-A ). Next, we return the behavior to the simulator by fitting the robot and object models to both views, without a human proxy or a pose detector (Sec. III-C ). Finally, we close the loop by rendering an edited keyframe back into the generator and enforcing it in reconstruction (Sec. III-D ).
paragraphs.zh: KinoGen 的流程分为四个阶段。 我们首先通过让视频生成器以目标机器人自身的渲染图像为条件，来为生成提供基础（第 III-A 节）。 接着，我们将生成的视频与机器人的运动先进行协调，以便用合理的运动初始化重建过程（第 III-B 节）。 然后，我们通过将机器人和物体模型拟合到两个视角中，无需人类代理或姿态检测器，便将行为反馈回模拟器（第 III-C 节）。 最后，我们将编辑后的关键帧重新渲染并输入生成器，同时强制将其应用于重建过程，从而完成闭环（第 III-D 节）。

sents.en: We resolve each of these issues through how the initial state is rendered into the conditioning image, as described next.

paragraphs.en: Conditioning on the rendered initial state. III-C ).

paragraphs.en: The generated video specifies the desired interaction visually but does not provide the 3D state that a reference requires. We therefore convert it into calibrated observations and initializations for reconstruction, as shown in Fig. 2 (middle). The two-view frames I ^ t , c \hat{I}_{t,c} are not associated with the robot model, and their depth carries no metric scale. We thus begin by extracting instance masks, robot surface-point tracks, and metric depth that tie every frame and view to the known geometry. These observations alone do not determine the motion. Framewise fitting of the redundant humanoid can match the images while producing incoherent or implausible motion, robot masks only weakly constrain the hands, and frequent hand–object occlusion makes direct object fitting sensitive to initialization. We therefore reconcile body, hand, and object priors with both views to initialize the body, hand, and object trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Calibrated visual evidence. From each generated frame I ^ t , c \hat{I}_{t,c} , we extract instance masks M t , c e M^{e}_{t,c} for the entities e ∈ { r , o , L , R } e\in\{\mathrm{r},\mathrm{o},\mathrm{L},\mathrm{R}\} , robot surface-point tracks 𝐮 t , c , j \mathbf{u}_{t,c,j} indexed by surface point j j , and metric depth D t , c D_{t,c} , which together link the generated views to the known robot, object, and camera geometry. After splitting the two views, we fold all crop and resize transformations into the calibrated camera intrinsics. We initialize the generic segmentation model SAM 3 [ 2 ] with the exact frame- 0 0 robot, object, and hand masks and propagate each instance independently. From the known frame- 0 0 robot configuration, we project 650 visible robot surface points per view and propagate their image positions using a generic point tracker TAPNext++ [ 13 ] . This associates image measurements directly with the target robot model without training a robot-specific keypoint or pose detector. Points are initialized only at frame 0 0 ; tracks that become occluded or inconsistent with the robot mask are marked invalid. Because monocular depth has unknown metric scale, we estimate temporally consistent relative depth with Video Depth Anything [ 5 ] and calibrate it using analytic intersections between camera rays and the ground plane. The robot and object pixels are excluded from the fit. The resulting instance masks, robot surface-point tracks, and metric depth maps are used to reconcile the priors below and for cross-view reconstruction in Sec. III-C .

paragraphs.en: Whole-body motion prior. paragraphs.en: Hand and object pose priors. We initialize the wrist orientation and finger articulation of each hand with the image-based hand estimator WiLoR [ 25 ] and triangulate its palm position from the two views. This hand estimate is the only quantity in the pipeline obtained with a human body model, and it serves only as initialization. Each 11-joint robot hand is represented by three coupled coordinates: thumb flexion, shared flexion of the remaining fingers, and thumb abduction-. The hand prior initializes them with rule-based mappings. Direct fitting subsequently refines all three. For the object, we run the pose tracker FoundationPose [ 29 ] independently in both views and select the candidate with the best cross-view agreement. These observations and initializations are the inputs to cross-view reconstruction in Sec. III-C .
paragraphs.zh: 手与物体姿态先验。 我们使用基于图像的手估计器 WiLoR [ 25 ] 初始化每只手的腕部朝向和手指关节，并通过两个视角对其手掌位置进行三角测量。 这种手估计是整个流程中唯一通过人体模型获得的量，且仅用作初始化。 每个包含 11 个关节的机器人手由三个耦合坐标表示：拇指屈曲、其余手指的共享屈曲以及拇指外展。 手姿态先验通过基于规则的映射对其进行初始化。 随后，直接拟合会进一步优化这三个坐标。 对于物体，我们在两个视角中独立运行姿态追踪器 FoundationPose [ 29 ]，并选择跨视角一致性最佳的候选结果。 这些观测值和初始化值构成了第 III-C 节中跨视角重建的输入。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction returns the generated behavior to the simulator by fitting the robot and object models to both views, as shown in Fig. 2 (middle). From the observations and initializations of Sec. III-B , it recovers the complete reference q 1 : T q_{1:T} . Because we optimize directly in the robot configuration space and the object pose space, the recovered reference lies in these spaces by construction. Every image term renders the current estimate with ℛ c \mathcal{R}_{c} and compares it with the masks, tracks, and depth extracted from I ^ t , c \hat{I}_{t,c} , following a render-and-compare formulation [ 16 ] . We fit the hands, the body, and the object in sequence rather than jointly, because the views observe each of them differently. The small image region of a hand cannot reliably drive the complete robot chain, so each hand is first solved as a floating base. The whole body is then solved from the reconciled body prior, with the finger coordinates fixed and the wrists constrained to the hand solution. The object, which the hands frequently occlude, is solved last with the reconstructed robot fixed, so that object-pose ambiguity cannot corrupt the robot motion and occlusion by the solved parts is accounted for. Each solve optimizes its configuration variables directly with Adam.
paragraphs.zh: 重建过程通过将机器人和物体模型与两个视图进行拟合，将生成的行为返回到模拟器中，如图 2（中间）所示。根据第 III-B 节的观察结果和初始化信息，该过程可恢复完整的参考轨迹 q₁:T。由于我们直接在机器人的构型空间和物体的位姿空间中进行优化，因此恢复出的参考轨迹在构造上就位于这些空间中。每个图像项都使用 ℛc \mathcal{R}_{c} 渲染当前估计值，并将其与从 I^t, c \hat{I}_{t,c} 中提取的掩码、跟踪信息和深度进行比较，遵循“渲染-比较”的公式 [16]。我们依次而非联合地拟合手部、躯干和物体，因为不同视图对它们的观察方式各不相同。手部在图像中的区域较小，无法可靠地驱动整个机器人链，因此每个手部分先作为浮动基座进行求解。随后，基于协调后的躯干先验信息求解整个躯干，其中手指坐标保持固定，手腕则受限于手部的求解结果。物体经常被手部遮挡，因此最后进行求解，此时重建后的机器人构型已固定，这样物体位姿的歧义就不会破坏机器人的运动，同时也能考虑到被已求解部分遮挡的影响。每次求解都直接使用 Adam 优化器对其构型变量进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Policy training and evaluation. To evaluate the downstream utility of each reconstructed reference q 0 : T q_{0:T} , we train a state-based reference-tracking policy in simulation. Following DeepMimic-style tracking [ 24 ] , the policy conditions on robot proprioception, object states and the reference phase, and outputs target joint commands for the low-level controller. Its reward tracks the reference robot and object motion and the hand–object relative transform, with regularization for smooth control. The policy architecture, observations, reward, simulator settings, training procedure, and training budget are identical for every reference source with only the reference trajectories differing. We report task success if the robot doesn’t fall and the position tracking error is less than 0.2 m. We also report reference deviation measured as robot bodies tracking error, and the area under the reward-versus-environment-step curve divided by total iteration. We train with 8,192 parallel environments for 6,000 PPO updates and repeat 10 times with different seeds to obtain the averaged results.
paragraphs.zh: 策略训练与评估。 为了评估每个重构参考 q₀: T q_{0:T} 的下游效用，我们在模拟中训练一种基于状态的参考跟踪策略。 遵循 DeepMimic 风格的跟踪方法 [24]，该策略以机器人本体感知、物体状态和参考阶段为条件，并输出低层控制器的目标关节指令。 其奖励函数跟踪参考机器人和物体的运动以及手与物体的相对变换，并通过正则化实现平滑控制。 对于每个参考源，策略架构、观测信息、奖励函数、模拟器设置、训练流程和训练预算均完全相同，仅参考轨迹不同。 如果机器人未发生坠落且位置跟踪误差小于 0.2 米，则我们判定任务成功。 我们还报告参考偏差，该偏差通过机器人本体跟踪误差衡量，以及奖励-环境步数曲线下的面积除以总迭代次数所得的值。 我们在 8,192 个并行环境中进行训练，执行 6,000 次 PPO 更新，并使用不同的随机种子重复实验 10 次以获得平均结果。

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether kinematically grounded generation and reconstruction produces higher-quality references than human or partial reconstruction, we compare against two types of video-based humanoid reference pipelines. GenMimic [ 22 ] and GRAIL [ 31 ] reconstruct generated human interactions from retargeting. GenHOI [ 1 ] conditions video generation on a rendered target-robot scene, but uses a human pose estimation model to recover a human motion sequence and then retarget it to the humanoid. In contrast, our method directly reconstructs the complete robot, dexterous-hand, and object trajectories in their target configuration spaces from calibrated multi-view visual evidence.

paragraphs.en: To place these baselines on the same task instances, we follow GRAIL’s scene-conditioning protocol for GenMimic and GRAIL: in each initial simulator render, we replace the robot with a robot-proportioned human character while keeping the environment fixed. We then generate one human–object interaction video and provide the same clip to GenMimic and GRAIL. Each method completes reconstruction and retargeting according to its own pipeline. Our method and GenHOI instead generate the corresponding target-robot video from the same task instance. Thus, the comparison preserves scene and task content while evaluating the different human-retargeting and direct-robot reconstruction strategies. We report the following metrics: total penetration aggregates robot–object, self-, and robot–ground penetration; foot skating measures the horizontal velocity of planted feet; contact preservation is the fraction of annotated contact frames with a hand–object distance below 2 cm; and smoothness measures root translational acceleration. For each penetration type, we multiply the mean depth over penetrating frames by the fraction of frames containing that penetration. Contact frames are obtained from VLM-reviewed annotations of the corresponding generated source video. Smoothness is computed as the mean magnitude of the second temporal derivative of the root position.

paragraphs.en: Table I shows that KinoGen produces the most physically consistent and task-aligned references overall. It achieves the lowest total penetration and foot-skating velocity, while recovering 91.16% of annotated contact frames, compared with 69.40% for the strongest baseline. GRAIL produces the lowest root acceleration, but KinoGen remains smoother than GenMimic and GenHOI while providing substantially better contact preservation and physical feasibility, which is aligned with the qualitative illustration in Fig. 5 . These improvements also translate to downstream control: policies trained on our references achieve the highest success rate, the lowest reference deviation, and the largest learning-curve AUC. Together, the results indicate that directly reconstructing the target embodiment from kinematically grounded video yields references that are both geometrically coherent and more useful for policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 显示，KinoGen 在总体上生成了物理一致性和任务对齐性最强的参考数据。 其总穿透率和脚部滑移速度最低，同时恢复了 91.16% 的标注接触帧，而最强基线模型仅恢复了 69.40%。 GRAIL 产生的根加速度最低，但 KinoGen 仍比 GenMimic 和 GenHOI 更平滑，同时在接触保持和物理可行性方面表现显著更好，这与图 5 中的定性示例一致。 这些改进也体现在下游控制中：基于我们参考数据训练的策略实现了最高的成功率、最低的参考偏差以及最大的学习曲线 AUC。 综合来看，这些结果表明，直接从具有运动学基础的视频中重建目标实体，能够生成既在几何上连贯又对策略学习更有用的参考数据。

paragraphs.en: Table II shows that kinematic grounding requires calibrated multi-view evidence, point tracks and motion priors. Using only one view reduces worst-view IoU and increases EPE, showing that the second view is important for resolving ambiguity. Without body prior, root acceleration increases from 0.37 to 1.01 m/s 2 and penetration increases from 10.5 to 26.8 mm, indicating that image fitting alone does not provide coherent whole-body motion. Removing hand prior also increases acceleration and penetration, as inaccurate hand targets propagate to the arm and body during refinement. Point tracks reduce EPE while leaving silhouette overlap nearly unchanged, showing that they constrain internal articulation that silhouettes cannot observe. Together, the multi-view evidence determines where the motion occurs, point tracks provide evidence for internal articulation, while the motion priors keep the motion consistent with the common robot motions. These parts ensure that the method grounds the kinematics of the scene while reconstructing the motion.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 显示，运动学定位需要经过校准的多视角证据、点迹和运动先验。 仅使用一个视角会降低最差视角的 IoU 并增加 EPE，这表明第二个视角对于消除歧义至关重要。 如果没有身体先验，根加速度会从 0.37 增加到 1.01 m/s²，穿透量则会从 10.5 增加到 26.8 mm，这说明仅靠图像拟合无法提供连贯的全局运动。 移除手部先验也会增加加速度和穿透量，因为不精确的手部目标会在优化过程中传播到手臂和身体。 点迹能够降低 EPE，同时几乎不改变轮廓重叠度，这表明它们约束了轮廓无法观察到的内部关节运动。 综合来看，多视角证据决定了运动发生的位置，点迹为内部关节运动提供了依据，而运动先验则使运动与常见的机器人动作保持一致。 这些部分共同确保了该方法在重建运动的同时，能够正确定位场景中的运动学关系。

paragraphs.en: We compare three variants. Without correction reconstructs the original cue-conditioned video. End-effector interpolation imposes the metric keyframe, preserves the hand–object transform, and directly interpolates the operating-hand translation and orientation between neighboring keyframes before solving per-frame IK. This baseline satisfies the endpoint but has no prior for how to approach it. The full model instead regenerates the motion around the metric keyframe before reconstruction and hard constraint enforcement, allowing the video prior to propose a lift-over and approach motion around the table. Figure 6 illustrates this difference in the intervening motion: direct interpolation crosses the table, whereas keyframe-conditioned generation produces an approach around the support surface. For each region, we report the mean distance between the reconstructed bottle and its target. We quantify collision error as the mean, over trials, of the maximum support-normal translational penetration against the table, taking the worse value between the bottle and operating right hand. Penetrations within a 2 mm tolerance are set to zero. Thus, placement error measures constraint satisfaction, while penetration distinguishes a feasible approach from merely interpolating to the correct endpoint.

sents.en: Without correction reconstructs the original cue-conditioned video.

sents.en: The full model instead regenerates the motion around the metric keyframe before reconstruction and hard constraint enforcement, allowing the video prior to propose a lift-over and approach motion around the table.

sents.en: Figure 6 illustrates this difference in the intervening motion: direct interpolation crosses the table, whereas keyframe-conditioned generation produces an approach around the support surface.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了中间运动方面的这种差异：直接插值会穿过桌子，而由关键帧条件化的生成则会绕着支撑面进行接近动作。

sents.en: For each region, we report the mean distance between the reconstructed bottle and its target.
sents.zh: 对于每个区域，我们报告重建瓶子与其目标之间的平均距离。

sents.en: We quantify collision error as the mean, over trials, of the maximum support-normal translational penetration against the table, taking the worse value between the bottle and operating right hand.
sents.zh: 我们将碰撞误差量化为各次试验中最大支撑面法向平移穿透桌子的平均值，并取瓶子和操作右手之间的较大值。

sents.zh: 在 2 毫米容限内的穿透值被设为零。

sents.en: Thus, placement error measures constraint satisfaction, while penetration distinguishes a feasible approach from merely interpolating to the correct endpoint.
sents.zh: 因此，放置误差衡量的是约束满足程度，而穿透则能区分可行的接近动作与仅仅插值到正确终点的动作。

paragraphs.en: Table III shows that visual conditioning alone does not provide reliable metric control. Without correction, the placement error varies from 1.07 to 14.55 cm across the three regions. Direct end-effector interpolation reaches every target exactly, but produces large penetration because the endpoint does not specify how the robot should approach it. By using this naive interpolation, the robot lifts up the bottle and directly moves through the table. Our full method satisfies every target exactly and reduces the penetration significantly. The method therefore gives the user precise metric customization over the generated reference, while video generation serves as a behavior interpolator between the grounded keyframes.

paragraphs.en: We presented KinoGen, a framework for synthesizing customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. By using the same target robot and object models to condition generation and reconstruct motion, KinoGen recovers whole-body, dexterous-hand, and object trajectories directly in the target configuration spaces, without full-body human-motion reconstruction or body retargeting. Calibrated multi-view evidence and complementary motion priors reconcile generated behavior with the target embodiment and metric task instance, yielding references with improved physical consistency that support tracking on a Unitree G1. This grounding further enables users to edit robot–object keyframes and use video generation as a behavior-aware interpolator, while constrained reconstruction enforces the prescribed configurations with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 KinoGen，一个通过基于运动学的视频生成来合成可定制的人形机器人移动与操作参考的框架。 通过为生成过程提供条件并重建运动时始终使用相同的目标机器人和物体模型，KinoGen 能够直接在目标构型空间中恢复全身、灵巧手及物体的轨迹，而无需进行完整的人体运动重建或身体重映射。 经过校准的多视角证据与互补的运动先验将生成的行为与目标实体及度量任务实例相协调，从而产生物理一致性更强的参考动作，这些参考动作支持在 Unitree G1 上的跟踪。 这种基于物理的生成方法还使用户能够编辑机器人与物体的关键帧，并将视频生成用作一种感知行为的插值器；同时，受约束的重建过程能够强制执行预设的构型，且比直接插值产生的穿透现象显著减少。

paragraphs.en: The current design has three limitations. Reconstruction is vulnerable to severe or persistent occlusion, under which masks, point tracks, and depth provide little visual evidence. More broadly, the quality and diversity of the recovered references are bounded by the video generator. Behaviors that are temporally inconsistent, geometrically implausible, or absent from its prior cannot always be recovered through reconstruction. Finally, the pipeline steers the generated behavior only through sparse keyframes, which constrain selected states but leave the intervening motion to the generator. Future work will investigate denser and more interactive feedback between generation and simulation, so that generated videos are continually grounded in the known scene geometry, robot kinematics, and task constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的设计存在三个局限性。 重建方法在面对严重或持续的遮挡时容易失效，此时掩码、点迹和深度信息几乎无法提供有效的视觉证据。 更广泛地说，恢复出的参考样本的质量与多样性受到视频生成器的限制。 那些在时间上不一致、几何上不合理，或在其历史数据中不存在的行为，无法总是通过重建方法恢复。 最后，该流程仅通过稀疏的关键帧来引导生成的行为，这些关键帧虽然约束了特定状态，但中间的运动仍由生成器自行决定。 未来的工作将研究生成与模拟之间更密集、更具交互性的反馈机制，从而确保生成的视频始终基于已知的场景几何结构、机器人运动学以及任务约束。
